title: Personal data export
limited: Synthetic export. Text, media, private evidence, identifiers, and ballot choices are excluded. A category may be limited to 100 records.
changed: The source data changed. Revoke this export and submit a new test case.
conflict: This export action conflicts with the current case or session.
failure: The export could not be prepared or read. Check its status and try again.

state.failed_retryable: Preparation failed. Retry or revoke this test export.
